title: Acute & Severe Headache Evaluation
description: Evaluation of cephalalgia with screening for secondary life-threatening intracranial emergencies.

risk_rules.name: Thunderclap Headache / Subarachnoid Hemorrhage Warning
risk_rules.reason: Reported sudden-onset, explosive headache reaching maximum severe intensity within minutes (thunderclap pattern). Consistent with urgent intracranial vascular pathology such as subarachnoid hemorrhage.
risk_rules.possible_concern: Acute intracranial vascular emergency (Subarachnoid hemorrhage concern)

risk_rules.name: Meningeal Irritation / Intracranial Infection Pattern
risk_rules.reason: Headache co-occurring with stiff neck (nuchal rigidity), fever, photophobia, or altered mental clarity. Clinical signs consistent with meningitis or encephalitis.

risk_rules.name: Headache with Focal Neurological Deficits
risk_rules.reason: Headache combined with new weakness, numbness, visual field defects, or confusion warrants urgent neuroimaging.
risk_rules.possible_concern: Secondary intracranial lesion or cerebrovascular event

risk_rules.name: Probable Migrainous Episode without Red Flags
risk_rules.reason: Unilateral, pulsating or severe headache associated with nausea, photophobia, or phonophobia, without acute thunderclap onset or focal neurological deficits.

risk_rules.name: Tension-Type Headache Pattern
risk_rules.reason: Bilateral, mild-to-moderate band-like tightening headache without fever, nausea, vomiting, sudden onset, or neurological deficits.

possible_conditions.name: Acute intracranial vascular concern
possible_conditions.reason_template: Sudden peak headache ('worst headache of life') with rapid progression within minutes.
possible_conditions.caveat: Requires immediate emergency medical evaluation and urgent non-contrast CT head imaging.

possible_conditions.name: Migraine
possible_conditions.reason_template: Severe unilateral throbbing headache, light or sound sensitivity, nausea, or previous similar episodes.
possible_conditions.caveat: Clinical decision support only. A medical professional should evaluate you to confirm diagnosis and optimize acute therapy.

possible_conditions.name: Tension-type headache
possible_conditions.reason_template: Pressure-like or dull ache across forehead or temples, neck muscle tension, absence of systemic red flags.
possible_conditions.caveat: Routine primary care follow-up is recommended if episodes increase in frequency.

recommended_questions.safety_relevance: Critical safety triage to detect explosive thunderclap onset.
recommended_questions.question: When did the headache start, and did it reach peak intensity within seconds or minutes?

recommended_questions.safety_relevance: Screens for catastrophic 'worst headache of life'.
recommended_questions.question: On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is this pain, and is it the most severe headache you have ever experienced?

recommended_questions.safety_relevance: Screens for nuchal rigidity associated with subarachnoid blood or meningeal infection.
recommended_questions.question: Do you have stiffness in your neck or difficulty bending your chin to your chest?

recommended_questions.safety_relevance: Detects central nervous system or systemic infectious etiology.
recommended_questions.question: Do you currently have a fever, chills, or body aches?
Are you experiencing any weakness on one side of your body, numbness, speech trouble, or vision changes?
